question.text: An AIF must report its fund activity to SEBI on:

answer.text: Quarterly basis, within 15 calendar days from the end of each quarter
Only at the time of winding up

explanation.text: The Logic: The Series XIX-A workbook states that AIF fund activity reporting to SEBI is on a quarterly basis, within 15 calendar days after the end of each quarter. Annual reporting is required to investors, and changes to the PPM or fund documents are intimated annually to SEBI and investors — but the question asks specifically about reporting to SEBI on fund activity. The Trap: "Daily basis" is operational, not regulatory. "Only when asked by SEBI" misreads the routine filing requirement. "Only at winding up" ignores ongoing reporting obligations entirely. Note: Pages 205, 211-212, 214, and 222 cover the reporting cadence for SEBI, investors, and PPM-change intimation. Match the cadence to the audience the stem names.
